scope: read-only post-evaluation numerical/provenance audit; no rerun, policy change or selection
limitations: All aggregates and loss/settling/reversal identities are independently recomputed from complete per-row extrema, not all underlying raw trajectories. Only 16 decimated diagnostic trajectories were stored; their first actual POSITION command times and sample-extrema bounds were checked. No evaluations were rerun.

Reversal before/after uses first actual position command SENT, with an inclusive boundary; categories neither/before_only/after_only/both are mutually exclusive. Additional actuation delay and residual dynamics preclude causal attribution to position control.

The four synthetic-test subgroup definitions were fixed in an audit message before outcomes were read. They are exploratory descriptive comparisons without significance testing, model selection or tuning. Speed means absolute one-dimensional initial snapshot velocity. The 0.414944 m/s threshold comes from prior capture-entry observations and is not a validated response envelope.

The 21 regression cases reuse 7 measured initial states with 3 synthetic target gaps; their trajectories use assumed nominal position dynamics. They are not 21 independent flights or a physical held-out success rate.

All position-controller gains/delays/saturation and plant perturbation ranges remain assumptions. Three-second terminal settling and lower scalar loss do not establish persistent hovering, absence of earlier reversal, causation, or hardware safety.
